answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the comet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The zephyr holds work receipts rather than names, so the glacier of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit.
